widget.instructions: Step through the explanation; tick Tilted axes at any time to compare the two sets of axes.

steps.text: A block rests on a 30° slope. Its weight points straight down, but on a slope only two directions matter: along the slope and across it.
Turn the axes so that one runs along the slope and the other straight out of it.
Now the weight re-projects onto the new axes: mg sin θ along the slope and mg cos θ into it.
The plank pushes back only against the part pressing into it, so the normal force is mg cos θ, not mg.

accessibility.altText: A block on a slope at 30° with its weight drawn straight down.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Tick Tilted axes; the description below the board lists each force and its components.
